subject: Wire shell_exec approval gating to approval workflow
description:
In `capo/tools/basic.py`, change `shell_exec` so that non-allowlisted invocations (the `ApprovalRequired` Phase 2 stub) instead spawn the approval workflow with `action_kind='shell_exec'` and `action_payload={'command': ..., 'cwd': ...}`. On approve, execute; on deny/expire, return a clear tool error to the agent.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] Non-allowlisted commands trigger the approval workflow (no longer raise `ApprovalRequired` to the agent loop).
- [ ] Approval question text describes the command and cwd clearly enough for the user to make a decision.
- [ ] On approve: command executes via the same allowlist-bypassing code path; the result is returned to the agent normally.
- [ ] On deny/expire: tool returns a structured error to the agent ("user denied" / "approval expired").

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Approval timed out: tool error includes "expired"; agent should NOT auto-retry.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Integration: non-allowlisted command → approval question → approve → command runs
• Integration: same flow with deny → command does not run; agent sees "denied"
• Integration: same flow with timeout → command does not run; agent sees "expired"

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 5.8, 6.2, 9.4
